purpose: The Payment Gateway processes card payments from merchants, routes them to acquiring banks, and publishes payment events.

components.name: Payments Edge Gateway
components.evidence: Merchant backends call the Payments Edge Gateway with a payment request that carries a card token.

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: payments-core stores payment records in payments-db (PostgreSQL), sends authorization requests to the acquirer through the Acquirer connector and publishes status events on payment-events (Kafka).

components.name: payments-db
components.evidence: payments-core stores payment records in payments-db (PostgreSQL).
